title: Mallworld drawing
content: Here's a rough drawing of my mallworld & surrounding areas (there were many things I could not fit). A few notes of what I was trying to depict: \-Food court immediately upon entering mall. Winding halls of stores. Hard to read: but some of the stores include an arcade, blockbuster, claires/accessories store... There's a candy store up in one of the corners. It's a big round store with all glass walls (shaped like a circle). \-There's a part of the mall that leads to school world.. There's a large loft area (study area or computer lab) with a balcony that overlooks a cafeteria \-Behind the food court, there's a staircase that leads into a small "card" store.. like a lame hallmark or something. There are kiddy tunnels, ballpits and slides towards the back of this room. Sometimes you have to enter through the slide. \-There's a large department store (like a boscov's, jc penny, bonton) connected to the mall. \-The parking lot is always dark and empty. If I turn out of the mall, it's normally storming outside. \-If I turn out of the mall and head to my left, this leads me to the "fairylands" (posted about this location previously) \-There is also a road that leads to the "wild west" as I call it in my journal. This is a very poor way of describing this area.. I just have no words for it. It's a mix of windy backroads and paths that lead to different neighborhoods. \-Up behind the mall is a road that leads to a neighborhood of mansions. The mansions never have any landscaping or life to them. They are simply enormous houses spread apart in a quiet neighborhood. I love exploring the mansions! There's usually someone home, but it's always quiet. They never seem startled when I enter their home unwelcomed. They usually look confused but I normally play it off and act like I'm there for something and everything is fine. \-Past the mansion neighborhood, there's a walmart/superstore & some other retail and food spots. There's usually a lot of driving between mansion world & this area.. I always feel like it's suchhh a long trek to make it up there. There's a Wendy's nearby, but you have to go through the drive-thru in a log flume (similar to a water park ride) &#x200B; https://preview.redd.it/rk8fhk9m6dk91.jpg?width=4032&format=pjpg&auto=webp&s=f80fc57160b4541bf18a49b1ea0c1aed2976f223
